headline: Casas Bahia Reports Q3 Loss Amid Audit Concerns
summary: Casas Bahia reported a third-quarter loss of R$ 731 million, exacerbated by a R$ 708 million provision related to its former subsidiary GPA. An audit has raised concerns regarding the company's business continuity.
why: Casas Bahia is one of Brazil's largest retail chains; its financial health is a critical indicator of the retail sector's stability.

impacts.name: Casas Bahia
impacts.why: Significant losses and audit warnings regarding business continuity are severe negative signals.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The combination of a large quarterly loss and an auditor's warning about business continuity creates significant uncertainty for investors.
